title: Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization for Autonomous AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.05632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous software agents can act through tools, delegate work, and change their models or execution environments while earlier authorizations remain in flight. We present Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization (ACCA), an approach designed to be harness-independent, for maintaining operational authority according to currently justified assurance. It distinguishes evidence validity from contextual applicability, derives assurance claims from eligible evidence, and resolves a multidimensional effective-authority envelope within a principal-declared ceiling and applicable policy. A typed dependency graph supports selective re-evaluation of authorization-relevant changes. An authority epoch changes when effective authority changes; a distinct optional authorization-basis version supports revalidation of action-specific authorization conditions. translated_title: 面向自主AI智能体的保证条件化持续授权
translated_abstract: 自主软件智能体可以通过工具执行操作、委派任务，并在先前的授权仍在进行时更改其模型或执行环境。我们提出了保证条件化持续授权（ACCA），这是一种设计为与执行框架无关的方法，用于根据当前有正当依据的保证来维持操作权限。该方法区分证据有效性与情境适用性，从合格证据中推导保证声明，并在主体声明的上限和适用策略范围内解析多维有效权限包络。类型化依赖图支持对与授权相关的变更进行选择性重新评估。当有效权限发生变化时，权限纪元会发生变更；一个独立的可选授权依据版本支持对特定操作的授权条件进行重新验证。受保护的效果时强制执行机制可以在产生重大后果的资源操作之前拒绝过期操作。
tldr: 提出了保证条件化持续授权（ACCA）框架，通过区分证据有效性与情境适用性、类型化依赖图的选择性重评估、权限纪元机制和效果时强制执行，使自主AI智能体的操作权限能够根据当前有正当依据的保证进行持续动态调整。
en_tdlr: Proposes Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization (ACCA), a harness-independent framework that dynamically maintains operational authority for autonomous AI agents based on currently justified assurance, using typed dependency graphs for selective re-evaluation, authority epochs, and effect-time enforcement to reject stale actions.
